_instructions: Template for /visualize project-map. Claude fills this in from repo analysis. Delete _instructions and _field_guide before saving the final version. Use the layers format — it is what the renderer supports.

_field_guide.title: Page heading shown at the top
_field_guide.subtitle: One-line summary (e.g. '5 services · 3 data stores · 2 external APIs')
_field_guide.side_rails: Optional array of cross-cutting concern cards shown flanking the main layers. Each has: id, title, subtitle, detail, side ('left' or 'right'). Use for: auth middleware, logging, config, shared libraries.
_field_guide.layers: Main content as ordered vertical layers. Use flow_label to label the arrow between layers. Each layer has: id, label, description (optional), style ('highlight' for emphasis), then ONE OF: cards, columns, exchanges, decisions.

layer_types.cards: Flat horizontal row of card objects. Use for a single tier of components at the same abstraction level.
layer_types.columns: Array of column objects each with a label and cards. Use to group cards within a layer by sub-category (e.g. 'Frontend' vs 'Backend' services).
layer_types.exchanges: Array of {left, right, request_label, response_label} for back-and-forth flows (API calls, queue messages, DB queries).
layer_types.decisions: Array of {question, outcomes[]} for branching flows (auth check → allow/deny, cache hit → return/fetch).
layer_types.notes: Array of {text, style ('info'|'warning'|'success'), icon} callout boxes within a layer.

card_fields.title: Display name shown in the box (keep short)
card_fields.subtitle: Second line — tech stack, type, or key fact
card_fields.detail: One clear sentence on what this component does
card_fields.responsibilities: Optional array of bullet-point responsibilities shown when expanded
card_fields.badge: Optional short label on a colored chip (e.g. 'API', 'DB', 'Cache')
card_fields.badge_color: Optional CSS color for the badge background
card_fields.icon: Optional emoji icon shown before the title
card_fields.accent: Optional left-border CSS color (e.g. '#e74c3c' for danger, '#27ae60' for safe)
card_fields.citations: Optional array of {file, lines, shows} — click-to-copy file references
card_fields.image: Optional image — local file path (embedded as base64), URL, or data URI
card_fields.image_position: Where to show the image: 'top' (above title, default) or 'detail' (inside expanded panel only)
card_fields.image_alt: Optional alt text for the image (defaults to card title)

layers._example_columns: Use columns when a layer has sub-groups side by side
layers.label: FRONTEND

cards.title: React SPA
cards.subtitle: TypeScript · Vite
cards.detail: Client-side app served as static files. Communicates with the API via fetch.

layers._example_exchange: Use exchanges for request/response flows between components
layers.label: API LAYER

left.title: Client Request
left.subtitle: Bearer token in header
left.detail: Every request after login carries the JWT in Authorization header.

right.title: Auth Middleware
right.subtitle: Validates JWT, sets req.user
right.detail: Rejects 401 if token is missing, expired, or tampered. Passes user context downstream.

question.title: Cache Hit?
question.subtitle: Redis TTL check
question.detail: Check Redis for the query key before hitting the DB.

outcomes.label: HIT
outcomes.title: Return Cached
outcomes.subtitle: ~2ms response
outcomes.detail: Returns cached JSON directly. No DB query.

outcomes.label: MISS
outcomes.title: Query DB
outcomes.subtitle: then write to cache
outcomes.detail: Runs parameterized SQL, writes result to Redis with TTL, returns data.

layers._example_cards: Use cards for a flat horizontal row at the same level
layers.label: DATA LAYER

cards.title: PostgreSQL
cards.subtitle: Primary store
cards.detail: All user and business data. Parameterized queries only. Transactions for multi-step writes.

cards.title: Redis
cards.subtitle: Cache + sessions
cards.detail: Short-TTL cache for hot queries. Session store for auth tokens.

cards.title: S3
cards.subtitle: File storage
cards.detail: Static assets and user uploads. Pre-signed URLs for direct client access.
